name: awen
description: Make and edit images, posters, videos, 3D models and documents with awen's creative agent, in your awen projects.

interface.longDescription: awen is a creative studio. Ask for images, posters, logos, videos, 3D models or documents, and awen's agent makes them in your awen project, following your team's memories and skills. You can also find, read and organise your projects, files and conversations.
capabilities: Make and edit images, posters and logos
Make videos from a brief or reference images
Follow the team's memories and skills
Find, read and organise projects and files
defaultPrompt: Make three poster ideas for our spring launch in awen.
Turn this product photo into a short video in awen.
Open awen and show me my recent work.

positive.description: Make poster ideas in a named project
positive.prompt: Make three poster ideas for our spring launch in my awen project Spring launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Spring launch project, starts one awen turn with the user's brief, shows awen's card while it works, then reports the three posters with links to them in awen.

positive.description: Make a short video from a brief
positive.prompt: Make a short video of a perfume bottle turning slowly on a marble table with awen, in my Spring launch project.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one awen turn in the Spring launch project with the brief, follows it until it ends, then reports the video with its link in awen.

positive.prompt: Show me what is still running in my awen projects.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's recent awen conversations across projects, says which ones still have a turn running, and spends no credits.

positive.prompt: Open awen and show me my recent work.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens awen's home: a box to describe what to make, the user's projects with their covers, what awen is generating now and the newest files, which open large. It spends no credits. From ChatGPT's sidebar, the awen entry opens the same home fullscreen.

positive.prompt: Find the logo files in my awen projects.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the matching files from the user's awen projects with their names, projects and links, and spends no credits.

positive.prompt: Which awen plan am I on, and how many credits have I used?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the awen organisation, its plan and the usage the user can see, without offering to sell credits or a plan.

negative.description: A coding request is not creative work
negative.prompt: Write a Python script that resizes every image in a folder on my computer.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers with the script directly and calls no awen tool.

negative.description: A request that does not say what to make
negative.expected_behavior: Asks what to make before calling create_with_awen, so no credits are spent.

negative.description: Deleting a project is not possible from an assistant
negative.prompt: Delete my awen project Spring launch.
negative.expected_behavior: Says that awen cannot delete a project from an assistant and that this stays in the awen app, and calls no write tool.

publication.release_notes: awen now has a home in ChatGPT's sidebar: describe what to make, pick a project or start from a goal, watch what awen is making, and open your projects and newest files.
